decisions_made: The indexing mismatch dispatch 34's handoff required be settled explicitly is settled by RE-INDEXING Phi_back/Phi_fwd to the combined periods (-G.NB -> G.winLo, G.NM+G.NF -> G.winHi), not by relating two indexings. Decisive reason: Timed.lean's prevTime_edge folds by G.NB, so an operator fixed for one G.nb-period constrains nothing about the fold TailStable exists to certify. Two supporting reasons and the reversal cost are recorded at the plan's Phase 16 heading and in the handoff.

L0 and R0 are sets of TWO-directionally live positions, read off G.liveT rather than G.fwdLiveT/G.bwdLiveT. Defining them from the one-directional fixpoints would have made the linchpin's reverse direction false, because fwdLiveT membership does not yield the bi-infinite run FwdLive demands. The transfer's soundness was therefore re-proved at that strength (live_subset_stepBack/live_subset_stepFwd), added alongside 16.1's forward-only pair rather than replacing it.

The reverse half of the linchpin was pursued to completion in this dispatch rather than deferred. It was first scoped out and committed in that state (16.2a carried a SCOPE section naming the three-region run as a later obligation), then landed, so the intermediate commit is a genuine green checkpoint and not a retracted claim.

No strengthening of the demand was needed, so the plan's Contingency branch (a deeper Phi iteration or a type-recurrence cut) was not taken and the fixture was not relaxed. One application of each period transfer suffices; iterBack_L0 is what makes it stand in for every later one, and it is not immediate from the equation because the reference time moves one period left with each application.

The right tail is a separate construction rather than a symmetry argument, because PlusSlicedCertificate is not symmetric under time reversal and runOfPos asks for succP steps; the right-tail chain runs along predP and is converted by mem_succP_iff_mem_predP.
